title: Wolf and Spire
author: Zephyrine Ravensworth
blurb: Xanthe Eastwick, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
